I turn messy data into actionable intel and compelling visuals. 
I recently finished my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone [analyzes fire severity on Indigenous and non-Indigenous land](capstone.qmd) 
and investigates the effect of prescribed burns and previous wildfires.

I care about LGBTQ+ issues, housing, clear and reproducible workflows, and explaining results to the person
who has to trust them.

**Currently looking for** data scientist roles
starting October 2026. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd).
